categories.main_business_segments: Changshu Guorui Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in maritime electrical and automation systems, focusing on the research, production, sales, and integrated technical services of ship and marine engineering electrical and automation systems. Its main products include ship power distribution systems, ship engine room automation systems, and aerospace automation systems. The company also actively develops new energy sectors such as nuclear power and wind power, and expands into aerospace and rail transit fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced electrical and automation technologies for ship systems, including medium-voltage distribution boards, main and emergency distribution boards, charging and discharging devices, and intelligent monitoring and control systems. It integrates digital manufacturing equipment and adopts a 'make-to-order' production model with efforts to standardize, modularize, and optimize product design and manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes R&D in LNG ship explosion-proof electro-hydraulic actuators, intelligent engine room systems, DC insulation monitoring, and water-cooled power units for high-power converters.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include shipowners, shipyards, and ship design institutes, mainly serving the shipbuilding and marine engineering equipment manufacturing industries. The company also supplies aerospace research institutes and has expanded into nuclear power, wind power, and aerospace sectors. Key customers include major shipyards such as Shanghai Waigaoqiao Shipbuilding Co., Ltd. and various government and commercial maritime entities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Changshu, Jiangsu Province. It is expanding its international market presence by establishing global warranty service networks and promoting product globalization aligned with the global shipbuilding industry's growth cycle.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changshu Guorui Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of ship electrical and automation equipment. It procures electronic components and raw materials upstream and supplies integrated systems and products downstream to shipbuilders and maritime operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with increased R&D investment, focusing on breakthroughs in key technologies to enhance product competitiveness and market share. Strategic R&D projects include developing advanced DC circuit breakers for new energy ships, water-cooled power units, and intelligent engine room monitoring systems. It fosters industry-academia-research collaboration and aims to build a comprehensive innovation chain integrating upstream and downstream partners, emphasizing green, intelligent, and high-end ship electrical automation solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized ship electrical distribution systems, engine room automation systems, and aerospace automation products. The company follows a direct sales model without intermediaries, engaging closely with customers for technical solutions and project bidding. It also earns income from providing technical services and leasing assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a competitive position as a specialized supplier in the ship electrical and automation systems sector, leveraging long-term partnerships with shipyards and research institutes. It competes in high-end maritime equipment markets and is expanding into emerging sectors like new energy ships and aerospace. The report does not specify named competitors but highlights the company's leadership in domestic ship electrical equipment manufacturing and its strategic focus on innovation and market expansion.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 277.55 million, a 41.49% increase year-over-year, though it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 38.07 million. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.23 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 1.00 billion, reflecting a 6.58% growth. Despite losses, the company improved its net loss excluding non-recurring items and maintained stable liquidity and a low debt ratio, supported by increased cash and cash equivalents.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changshu Guorui Technology emphasizes delivering high-quality, reliable, and intelligent maritime electrical automation solutions tailored to high-end ship types such as luxury cruise ships, LPG, and LNG vessels. Its value proposition includes comprehensive system integration capabilities, advanced technology innovation, and strong quality assurance certified by multiple domestic and international classification societies. The company differentiates itself through its full-chain production capacity, extensive patent portfolio, and commitment to green, intelligent, and energy-efficient ship electrical systems.
